comment:
* The UceController will manage the RCS UCE requests on a per subscription basis. When it receives
 * the UCE requests from the RCS applications and from the ImsService, it will coordinate the
 * cooperation between the publish/subscribe/options components to complete the requests.

variables.name: mDeviceState
variables.comment: The device state to execute UCE requests.

variables.name: mCachedCapabilityEvent
variables.comment: The cache of the capability request event triggered by ImsService

variables.name: mCtrlCallback
variables.comment:
* The implementation of the interface UceControllerCallback. These methods are called by other
     * controllers.

variables.name: mCapabilityEventListener
variables.comment: * Setup the listener to listen to the requests and updates from ImsService.

methods.name: public void onRcsConnected(RcsFeatureManager manager)
methods.comment: * The RcsFeature has been connected to the framework. This method runs on main thread.

methods.name: public void onRcsDisconnected()
methods.comment: * The framework has lost the binding to the RcsFeature. This method runs on main thread.

methods.name: public void onDestroy()
methods.comment: * Notify to destroy this instance. This instance is unusable after destroyed.

methods.name: public void onCarrierConfigChanged()
methods.comment: * Notify all associated classes that the carrier configuration has changed for the subId.

methods.name: public void requestCapabilities(@NonNull List<Uri> uriList, @NonNull IRcsUceControllerCallback c) throws RemoteException
methods.comment:
* Request to get the contacts' capabilities. This method will retrieve the capabilities from
     * the cache If the capabilities are out of date, it will trigger another request to get the
     * latest contact's capabilities from the network.

methods.name: private void requestCapabilitiesInternal(@NonNull List<Uri> uriList, boolean skipFromCache, @NonNull IRcsUceControllerCallback c) throws RemoteException
public void requestAvailability(@NonNull Uri uri, @NonNull IRcsUceControllerCallback c) throws RemoteException
methods.comment:
* Request to get the contact's capabilities. It will check the availability cache first. If
     * the capability in the availability cache is expired then it will retrieve the capability
     * from the network.

methods.name: public void onRequestPublishCapabilitiesFromService(@StackPublishTriggerType int triggerType)
methods.comment: * Publish the device's capabilities. This request is triggered from the ImsService.

methods.name: public void onUnpublish()
methods.comment:
* This method is triggered by the ImsService to notify framework that the device's
     * capabilities has been unpublished from the network.

methods.name: public void onPublishUpdated(@NonNull SipDetails details)
methods.comment:
* This method is triggered by the ImsService to notify framework that the device's
     * publish status has been changed.

methods.comment:
* Request publish the device's capabilities. This request is from the ImsService to send the
     * capabilities to the remote side.

methods.name: public void registerPublishStateCallback(@NonNull IRcsUcePublishStateCallback c, boolean supportPublishingState)
methods.comment: * Register a {@link PublishStateCallback} to receive the published state changed.

methods.name: public void unregisterPublishStateCallback(@NonNull IRcsUcePublishStateCallback c)
methods.comment: * Removes an existing {@link PublishStateCallback}.

methods.name: public int getUcePublishState(boolean isSupportPublishingState)
methods.comment: * Get the UCE publish state if the PUBLISH is supported by the carrier.

methods.name: public RcsContactUceCapability addRegistrationOverrideCapabilities(Set<String> featureTags)
methods.comment:
* Add new feature tags to the Set used to calculate the capabilities in PUBLISH. *

* Used for testing ONLY. * @return the new capabilities that will be used for PUBLISH.

methods.name: public RcsContactUceCapability removeRegistrationOverrideCapabilities(Set<String> featureTags)
methods.comment:
* Remove existing feature tags to the Set used to calculate the capabilities in PUBLISH. *

* Used for testing ONLY. * @return the new capabilities that will be used for PUBLISH.

methods.name: public RcsContactUceCapability clearRegistrationOverrideCapabilities()
methods.comment:
* Clear all overrides in the Set used to calculate the capabilities in PUBLISH. *

* Used for testing ONLY. * @return the new capabilities that will be used for PUBLISH.

methods.name: public RcsContactUceCapability getLatestRcsContactUceCapability()
methods.comment: * @return current RcsContactUceCapability instance that will be used for PUBLISH.

methods.name: public String getLastPidfXml()
methods.comment:
* Get the PIDF XML associated with the last successful publish or null if not PUBLISHed to the
     * network.

methods.name: public void removeRequestDisallowedStatus()
methods.comment:
* Remove the device disallowed state. *

* Used for testing ONLY.

methods.name: public void setCapabilitiesRequestTimeout(long timeoutAfterMs)
methods.comment:
* Set the milliseconds of capabilities request timeout. *

* Used for testing ONLY.

methods.comment: * Get the subscription ID.
